errors.evidence: The reference description explicitly states the chart 'veranschaulicht die prozentualen Durchschnittswerte des Welt-BIP, Welthandels, der Exporte Deutschlands und der Industrieproduktion Deutschlands.' The machine-generated description omits this explicit purpose, though it is implied.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind innerhalb jeder Jahrzehntgruppe nebeneinander angeordnet und nicht sortiert
errors.evidence: The reference description does not mention whether the bars are sorted or not, so stating they are 'nicht sortiert' introduces an assumption not present in the image or reference. The image does not provide evidence of sorting, but the claim is unnecessary.
The reference description mentions the tick intervals ('Teilstrichen im Abstand von 1,0') on the y-axis, which the machine-generated description omits.
